integrity: The uniform all-size conclusion follows from exhaustive checking of an exact finite factor with 2158 realizable saturated support signatures. Separate vertex-level enumerations corroborate but do not establish the infinite-family result. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns synchronous threshold-one three-color cyclic cellular automata on complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts; it does not cover different graphs, higher color counts, asynchronous updates or individual attractor basins. Primary novelty review is bounded by accessible literature, including a full-text general finite-graph theorem but only bibliographic access to the foundational 1993 source.
title: Two-step three-cycle collapse in multipartite cyclic competition
